archfiend_malgrath.bossLine: "Hell does not forget. Hell will send another."
archfiend_malgrath.narratorLine: The breach seals with a sound like a door slamming in the void.

dragon_king.bossLine: "A thousand years... and this is how... it ends?"
dragon_king.heroLine: "Every king falls. Even the last one."
dragon_king.narratorLine: The mountain goes quiet. The dragon's fire fades from the sky.

emberveil_sovereign.bossLine: "I am the Veil. The Veil... is everywhere..."
emberveil_sovereign.narratorLine: The Veil shudders. A door opens.

grax_veil_touched.bossLine: "The Veil... will not... be held back forever..."
grax_veil_touched.heroLine: "Rest now, Grax. The Breach dies with you."
grax_veil_touched.narratorLine: A tremor runs through the air. The Veil holds — for now.

lava_titan.narratorLine: Magma hardens around the titan's husk. Steam fills the caldera.

the_architect.bossLine: "I drew every outcome. In none of them... did I fall."
the_architect.narratorLine: Creation breathes. The blueprint crumbles to ash. It is over.

the_unraveler.bossLine: "You cannot destroy what was never whole."
the_unraveler.heroLine: "We didn't. We just put it back in the dark."
the_unraveler.narratorLine: Threads of reality knit themselves closed. Something recedes.

veil_stalker.narratorLine: The prologue ends. The real journey begins.

phases.name: Hellfire Unleashed
phases.onEnter: Malgrath throws back his head and laughs — then his form ignites. True demonic fire.

phases.name: Demonic Ascendance
phases.onEnter: Wings of pure hellfire tear from Malgrath's back. "None of you leave this pit alive."

phases.name: First Flame Rising
phases.onEnter: Bahamorth's scales ignite. Every breath now is an inferno. "You still breathe. Remarkable."

phases.name: The World Ends With Me
phases.onEnter: Bahamorth rears back and the mountain trembles. The sky outside goes dark with ash.

phases.name: Veil Ascendant
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign spreads arms wide — the Emberveil itself floods through the chamber.

phases.name: Sovereign Unbound
phases.onEnter: Flesh burns away, leaving a silhouette of pure Emberveil. "I am the Veil. The Veil does not fall."

phases.name: Veil-Rent
phases.onEnter: Grax tears the Veil open around himself — the air tastes like copper and rot.

phases.name: Last Breath
phases.onEnter: Grax howls with borrowed power — something inside him tears free!

phases.name: Molten Core
phases.onEnter: Cracks split the Titan's hide — magma pours from within. The ground beneath blisters.

phases.name: Pyroclastic Fury
phases.onEnter: The Titan erupts — superheated shards of stone scatter across the field!

phases.name: Reality Fraying
phases.onEnter: The Unraveler laughs without a mouth. Threads of reality unravel around it.

phases.name: The Hunger Made Manifest
phases.onEnter: IT SEES YOU. Not your face — your entire existence, threadbare and ready to dissolve.
